rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a radio, television, or other electronic transmitter, and can also refer generically to a transmitting device.

example.english: This transmitter is broken, so the radio station keeps failing to receive a signal.
example.traditional: 呢部發射器壞咗，電台成日收唔到訊號。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 faat3 se6 hei3 waai6 zo2 din6 toi1 seng4 jat6 sau1 m4 dou3 seon3 hou6

rows.note: Use this for a generic person or agent that transmits or passes something on when no technical field is specified.

example.english: Please write the transmitter’s name on the back of the envelope.
example.traditional: 請喺信封背面寫低傳送者嘅姓名。
example.jyutping: cing2 hai2 seon3 fung1 bui3 min6 se2 dai1 cyun4 sung3 ze2 ge3 sing3 ming4

rows.jyutping: san4 ging1 cyun4 dou6 mat6 zat1
rows.note: Use this specifically for a biochemical or neurotransmitter sense, such as dopamine or epinephrine in the nervous system.

example.english: Dopamine is a transmitter that affects our mood.
example.traditional: 多巴胺係一種神經傳導物質，會影響我哋嘅情緒。
example.jyutping: do1 baa1 on1 hai6 jat1 zung2 san4 ging1 cyun4 dou6 mat6 zat1 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 cing4 seoi5
